text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2% over the past day, with Bitcoin slightly underperforming, while Bitcoin dominance has held firm at 58.6% despite the broader selloff. The Fear & Greed index sits at 11—extreme fear—and has deteriorated over the past week, signaling sustained pessimism rather than a panic spike. The 24-hour volume of $94B suggests active liquidation and position unwinding, though not yet at crisis levels that would indicate capitulation.
